textTemplates.name: caseCloseBody
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!$Record.EYI_REC__r.EYI_First_Name__c} {!$Record.EYI_REC__r.EYI_Last_Name__c}, We hope this message finds you well. We are writing to inform you that your case #{!$Record.CaseNumber}, titled "{!$Record.Subject}", has been successfully resolved and is now closed. If you have any further questions or concerns related to this case, you can reply directly to this email within 48 hours. Upon receiving your response, we will promptly reopen the case for further review.
Case Details: Case Number: #{!$Record.CaseNumber}, Subject: {!$Record.Subject} Closure Date: {!$Record.ClosedDate} Thank you for choosing Panchshil Reality. We are here to assist you anytime.
Best regards, Panchshil Reality.
